execution_part.Description: The instruction truncates a 64-bit floating-point number to a 32-bit integer with saturation. If the conversion is successful, the result is pushed onto the stack.
The instruction attempts to truncate a floating-point number that cannot be represented as a 32-bit integer. This leads to a trap.
